name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: One vegetable, one protein, one pan, a hot oven. What goes on at the end decides which dinner it is.
season_anchor: Kabocha wedges, or sweet potato in cubes

variations.context: The default. A spoonful of the jar over everything, lemon squeezed on top.

variations.ingredients: Cool and sharp: salted yogurt + pomegranate
variations.context: Yogurt spread on the plate first, the hot pan tipped onto it, seeds over the top.

variations.ingredients: Bright and hot: lime + chile + garlic
variations.context: Warm olive oil with a grated garlic clove and chile flakes for a minute, then pour it over with lime.

finish: Heat the oven to 425°F. Squash, peppers, and all two pounds of sausage go on one pan together — use two pans if they crowd — oiled and salted, with room between the pieces. Roast about 30 minutes, turning the sausages once, until they're browned and the squash edges are dark. Eat what you want tonight; the rest is lunches and the skillet hash. Finish each plate in one of the three directions.
